analysis.consequence: aStarted=false forces pass=false. A's ASTART marker was never observed, so A's occupation of the maxConcurrent=1 slot is UNCONFIRMED. The intended premise (A runs and occupies the slot -> B queues behind it -> B is cancelled while queued -> A completes normally and frees the slot -> the cancelled B still never starts) is therefore NOT fully established.

what_is_supported.narrow_gate: A task observed in 'queued' state, once cancelled, did not start (its BSTART marker never appeared), and a later fresh session C ran to completion. This narrow observation stands.

what_is_NOT_supported: The full L18.QUEUED gate ('a cancelled QUEUED task must never start EVEN AFTER the slot frees via A completing NORMALLY') is not closed: A's start/normal-completion was never confirmed (aStartedMarker=false), and A was force-stopped rather than allowed to complete, so the 'slot frees naturally' path was never exercised.
resulting_verdict: L18.QUEUED narrow observation = supported; full gate = NOT CLOSED. Re-run in R5 as L18.QUEUED with: A confirmed started (ASTART observed) AND A allowed to COMPLETE NORMALLY (not force-stopped) so the slot frees on its own, then confirm cancelled B still never starts.
affects_pass_count: L18.QUEUED remains NOT a full functional PASS until the corrected re-run

resolution.result: FULL PASS: A started (ASTART marker) + observed running + completed NORMALLY (status done, ADONE marker) so the slot freed on its own; B queued -> cancelled -> stopped, BSTART marker never appeared even after the slot freed; C ran to completion. All via external markers; A not force-stopped.
